paper_title: SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware   Reinforcement Learning
caption_used: Accuracy comparison of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Each benchmark displays grouped bars for DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). In Mathverse, SRPO achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56%, while DAPO+Self-reflection follows at roughly 55%, with the remaining methods clustered between 53% and 54%. Across MMLU, GRPO leads with approximately 57%, narrowly exceeding DAPO+Self-reflection, and PPO trails at about 54.5%. In the Physics benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches roughly 61%, with SRPO close behind at 60.5% and PPO at the lowest with approximately 57%. Notably, the self-reflection variants do not consistently outperform their base counterparts, as GRPO surpasses PPO+Self-reflection in both Mathverse and MMLU.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма илюстрира точността на шест конфигурации за подсилващо обучение при три различни показателя: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Хоризонталната ос представя категориите Mathverse, MMLU и Physics, подредени в този ред. Вертикалната ос показва точността в проценти, с линейна скала, варираща от 50% до 62% с интервали от 2%.  Всяка категория съдържа групирани стълбове, представляващи DAPO+Self-reflection (твърдо синьо), DAPO (начертано синьо), SRPO (твърдо оранжево), GRPO (начертано оранжево), PPO+Self-reflection (твърдо зелено) и PPO (начертано зелено). В показателя Mathverse, стълбът за SRPO достига приблизително 56%, докато DAPO+Self-reflection е около 55%, а останалите методи са между 53% и 54%. За MMLU, GRPO има най-висока точност, около 57%,  малко над DAPO+Self-reflection, а PPO е около 54,5%. В Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection достига около 61%, а SRPO е близо зад него, около 60,5%, докато PPO е най-ниският, около 57%.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该图表显示了三种基准测试（Mathverse、MMLU 和 Physics）中六种强化学习配置的准确性比较。水平轴标有基准测试名称：Mathverse、MMLU 和 Physics，这些基准测试顺序排列。垂直轴标有“Accuracy (%)”，是一个线性刻度，范围从 50% 到 62%，数值刻度间隔为 2%。该图表由每个基准测试中的分组柱状图组成，每组包含六个柱状图，分别代表 DAPO+Self-reflection（纯蓝色）、DAPO（斜条纹蓝色）、SRPO（纯橙色）、GRPO（斜条纹橙色）、PPO+Self-reflection（纯绿色）和 PPO（斜条纹绿色）。在 Mathverse 中，SRPO 柱状图最高，为大约 56%，DAPO+Self-reflection 柱状图次之，为大约 55%，其余方法在 53% 到 54% 之间。在 MMLU 中，GRPO 柱状图高度最高，为大约 57%，略高于 DAPO+Self-reflection 柱状图，PPO 柱状图最低，为大约 54.5%。在 Physics 基准测试中，DAPO+Self-reflection 柱状图达到大约 61%，SRPO 柱状图紧随其后，为 60.5%，而 PPO 柱状图最低，为大约 57%。该图表中的柱状图按照测试顺序排列，无任何柱状图被以阴影、加粗或轮廓突出显示。
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of six reinforcement learning configurations—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO—across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the benchmarks, labeled “Mathverse,” “MMLU,” and “Physics” in that order, while the vertical axis represents accuracy in percent (%), with a linear scale ranging from 50% to 62% and tick marks at intervals of 2%. For each benchmark, there are six grouped bars, each representing a different reinforcement learning configuration. Within each benchmark’s groups, the order of the configurations is consistent: solid blue for DAPO+Self-reflection, hatched blue for DAPO, solid orange for SRPO, hatched orange for GRPO, solid green for PPO+Self-reflection, and hatched green for PPO. In Mathverse, the bar heights are approximately 55% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 54% for DAPO, 56% for SRPO, 54% for GRPO, 55% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 53% for PPO. For MMLU, the bar heights are approximately 57% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 56% for DAPO, 55% for SRPO, 57% for GRPO, 55% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 54.5% for PPO. In Physics, the bar heights are approximately 61% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 59.5% for DAPO, 60.5% for SRPO, 59% for GRPO, 60% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 57% for PPO. The bars are sorted by configuration within each benchmark, and no bars are visibly emphasized with shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm ist ein gruppiertes Balkendiagramm, das die Genauigkeit von sechs Reinforcement-Learning-Konfigurationen über drei Benchmarks vergleicht: Mathverse, MMLU und Physik. Die horizontale Achse zeigt die drei Benchmarks an, die in der Reihenfolge Mathverse, MMLU und Physik angeordnet sind. Die vertikale Achse stellt die Genauigkeit dar, die in Prozent angegeben ist und von 50 % bis 62 % skaliert wird, wobei die Tick-Markierungen in 1-Prozent-Schritten angeordnet sind. Für jeden Benchmark gibt es sechs nebeneinander liegende Balken, die DAPO+Self-reflection (solide blau), DAPO (gehätscht blau), SRPO (solide orange), GRPO (gehätscht orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solide grün) und PPO (gehätscht grün) darstellen. In Mathverse liegt die Höhe des SRPO-Balkens bei ungefähr 56 %, während der DAPO+Self-reflection-Balken bei ungefähr 55 % liegt, die anderen Methoden liegen zwischen 53 % und 54 %. In MMLU erreicht der GRPO-Balken etwa 57 %, dicht gefolgt von DAPO+Self-reflection, und PPO weist etwa 54,5 % auf. In der Physik-Benchmark erreicht DAPO+Self-reflection ungefähr 61 %, SRPO folgt dicht mit 60,5 %, während PPO die niedrigste Höhe mit ungefähr 57 % aufweist.
